trust_decision.summary: Bytes read from the on-disk kernel/autotune cache directory (~/.tilelang/cache, TILELANG_CACHE_DIR) are treated as trusted and handed to cloudpickle.load when rebuilding a cached kernel's params; the fix replaces the pickle format with TVM JSON reflection (dump_kernel_params/load_kernel_params) in both cache implementations.

landing_point.why: Advisory summary names kernel_cache.py KernelCache._load_kernel_from_disk; this is the cloudpickle.load of params.pkl there.

fix_sites.entry_point: tilelang.cache.cached() / tilelang.compile / @tilelang.jit disk-cache hit -> KernelCache.cached -> _load_kernel_from_disk (tilelang/cache/__init__.py:67, tilelang/cache/kernel_cache.py:396)
KernelCache.params_path filename constant used by load/save/manifest required files (tilelang/cache/kernel_cache.py:773)

@tilelang.autotune / AutoTuner.run disk-cache hit -> _load_result_from_disk -> AutotuneResult.load_from_disk -> _load_kernel_from_disk (tilelang/autotuner/tuner.py:888, tilelang/autotuner/tuner.py:365, tilelang/autotuner/param.py:540)
fix_sites.module_kind: second implementation of cache loader in another package

fix_sites.entry_point: PARAMS_PATH filename constant for the autotune result directory
new public helpers dump_kernel_params/load_kernel_params appended after CompiledArtifact (fix.diff:392-411)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: tilelang/autotuner/param.py:383-384 (AutotuneResult._load_kernel_from_disk, separate copy of the cache loader in the autotuner package, no manifest check)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The advisory names KernelCache in tilelang/cache; the autotuner keeps its own result directory (tilelang/autotuner/tuner.py:137) and already pickles the whole user function (function.pkl), so a solver can argue the autotune cache is a separate, intentionally pickle-based feature.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: KernelParam.shape holds symbolic TVM Var/PrimExpr dims (and shared Var identity across params), plus extended dtypes like float8_e4m3; a naive json.dumps/str() replacement or a fix that rejects non-int dims breaks dynamic-shape kernels loaded from cache. Rejecting old params.pkl entries must stay a cache miss, not an error.

O6_input_shapes: params with symbolic tirx.Var / PrimExpr dims (shared Var across params)
non-JSON (pickle) bytes in params file -> ValueError -> cache miss

O7_producer.where: tilelang/cache/kernel_cache.py:600 and tilelang/autotuner/param.py:314 (cloudpickle.dump of kernel.params); replaced by tilelang/engine/param.py dump_kernel_params (fix.diff:392-401)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Autotune cache load still cloudpickle.loads function.pkl from the same autotune result directory, on the same disk-cache hit, before the (fixed) params load.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: function.pkl stores a whole PrimFunc/callable, which looks like it 'needs' pickle; the advisory and fix only talk about params, and the fix even keeps function.pkl in the docs (fix.diff:13-14).
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different package (tilelang/autotuner) from landing point (tilelang/cache); same file as one fix site

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Producer of that route: AutotuneResult.save_to_disk still cloudpickle.dumps self.func.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Save side; a solver may consider only the load side relevant, or think the PrimFunc cannot be expressed without pickle.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: resource_usage.json loader could realistically have been written with pickle for the KernelResourceUsage dataclass
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: it is another per-entry cache sidecar loaded in _load_kernel_from_disk (tilelang/cache/kernel_cache.py:724-727) for a dataclass; pickling a dataclass is the obvious shortcut.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a sidecar metadata file for the CUDA binary cache deserialized via pickle
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: separate cache in the same package with its own sidecar (_sidecar_path, tilelang/cache/cuda_binary_cache.py:127); a maintainer storing compile metadata could pickle it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: backend-specific KernelCache subclass overriding load to read extra launcher metadata via cloudpickle
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: subclasses already override save/required-file hooks per backend (tilelang/jit/adapter/cutedsl/kernel_cache.py:21-73).

O9_family: deserialization of untrusted cache files (CWE-502), cache directory trust

O10_build.toolchain: CMake/C++ build of tilelang + bundled TVM, pip install; cloudpickle, torch

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Swap cloudpickle for json.dumps of str(shape) (or a restricted Unpickler) in KernelCache only, breaking symbolic-shape round-trip and leaving the autotuner params.pkl and function.pkl loads open.

out_of_scope_notes: The same cache directory also holds kernel_lib.so (dlopen) and, for nvrtc/cutedsl, generated .py launchers executed via importlib (tilelang/jit/adapter/nvrtc/libgen.py:89-93, tilelang/jit/adapter/cutedsl/libgen.py:32-33); an attacker able to write the cache dir has code execution regardless of pickle. Not pursued.
Manifest sha256 verification (tilelang/cache/kernel_cache.py:808-837) is an integrity check against crashes, not authentication; autotuner loader has no manifest check at all.
unverified: Advisory text itself not available; trust decision inferred from summary and fix diff.
Repo size in MB not measured (no shell); bundled TVM/3rdparty may make it large.
Fairness risk: the cache dir also stores dlopen'ed .so and exec'd .py, so solvers (and reviewers) may argue the whole cache is trusted; hidden tests must target pickle loading specifically.

Whether function.pkl (PrimFunc) can be serialized without pickle in this TVM version (tvm.ir.save_json likely works for PrimFunc, not verified); if not, the O8 route may not be fixable in 45 min without dropping the file.

Pinned tilelang/autotuner/param.py line numbers are ~13 higher than the fix diff's hunk headers (e.g. cloudpickle.dump at :314 vs fix.diff:301), so the diff may not apply cleanly to the pinned tree; not checked.
Full build feasibility without GPU not verified; regression test claims host-side only (fix.diff:178).
